judge-football.justification: Usable (5.5): scout rule (shrink drill burst ~70%, wait for 31 rush snaps) and protocol advice (cut backpedal, spend time on the 40) are concrete, but the headline is a null; the one positive (TE top speed, n=29) adds nothing the stopwatch lacks. A GM gets 'ignore it', not a ranking. Data difficulty (7.5): handles reliability and noise ceilings, shrinkage, year-standardized drills, alignment, man/zone and press/off controls, clip start, out-of-class validation, no-tracking baseline, multiplicity. Weak: ~6 random snaps per player, full tracking not used, opportunity only via shrinkage, no injuries; DL single-snap reliability 0.07 makes the null largely uninformative. Unique (8.0): same-player drill-to-game translation is a real reframing; noise-ceiling framing strong. Does not engage the known DL pressure vs 3-cone/40/shuttle signal; get-off rho -0.31 replaced by a null. Terminology (6.5): named players with picks and EDGE/interior roles. Issues: 'burst' in yd/s is speed not acceleration; pressure 5-11% looks low and pressure derivation without ball/opponents undefined; calling TE speed 'the 40' in a DL piece confusing; 'Dont'e Thornton' typo; calling 0.02 vs 0.29 ceiling a clear 'does not translate' overstates.
top_changes: Reframe DL null as underpowered not disproved; re-run on full 2.3 GB game tracking; report power/minimum-detectable-effect and make verdict conditional.
Add decision-ready per-position 2027 draft-room card: rank prospects by shrunk 40 top speed and drill percentile with intervals, flag drill-vs-film disagreement, add 'what would change my mind' rule.

Tighten football validity: define burst as first-second distance/mean speed, explain pressure without ball/opponent data, handle injury and snap opportunity, test 3-cone/shuttle/40 vs DL pressure; cut weak DB/WR detail.
fatal_flaws: Central DL null rests on ~6 random snaps/player with NFL single-snap reliability 0.07; cannot separate 'does not translate' from 'cannot be measured', yet headline says 'does not translate'.
Only positive finding (TE top speed, n=29) adds nothing beyond official 40.

judge-datascience.justification: Re-ran build_curves, residualize, eb_means on data/processed; headline numbers reproduced (n_drill_reps 2,243; n_game_plays 4,573; DL drill-vs-NFL burst Spearman 0.0236 p=0.818 n=97; reliabilities 0.170 drill / 0.069 NFL; TE top speed vs NFL peak speed rho 0.566 p=0.00138 n=29; 40 retest 0.986 n=375). Full script (permutation/bootstrap loops) not re-run. Strengths: no-tracking baseline (pick, EDGE share, weight, official 40, NGS); leave-one-class-out with per-fold R2, bootstrap, within-class permutation; year-standardized drills; ANOVA variance components, EB shrinkage, Spearman-Brown; noise ceilings; Holm and BH over 18 tests; admits 2025 fold R2 -0.28; OLS with 5-6 predictors suits n. Innovation above standard correlation work (onset detection, drill-to-play matching, self-referenced game metrics, disattenuated correlation). Weaknesses: DL true-score CI [-3.97,7.61] and DB [-1.43,14.57] unusable, DB withheld while WR shown; random-half inferred from |EPA| rank not stored flag; headline null underpowered, title overclaims; TE finding n=29 found after looking at 5 groups, bootstrap R2 [-0.46,0.50]; official 40 matches top speed (0.29 vs 0.30); EDGE share mechanically tied to outcome, weight_z not year-standardized; 'never let it move a player more than his 40' unsupported; Fig 2 compares 3.04 game peak with 4.30 drill value at 1.5 s; pre-contact window unchecked.
top_changes: Add power analysis/TOST for DL, WR, DB nulls using game reliability 0.07; retitle 'cannot detect a link, underpowered'; drop or explain unusable true-score CIs.
Make TE top-speed finding robust: LOCO with shrunk/ridge slope and permutation p; test whether tracked top speed adds over official 40; label exploratory; replicate on high-|EPA| half.

Fix baseline hygiene: store random-half flag in ETL; year-standardize weight; rerun with/without EDGE share; fold model for 2025; outcome reliability by seasons; replace unsupported rule with a tested one; align Fig 2 time points.

judge-writeup.justification: Check passes (1,794 words, 6 figures, 2 tables). Strong: title and lead state an honest null with n and CI; finalist structure with metric, named players, so-what, candid limitations. Weak: title is 20 words; metric definition not coach-repeatable ('relative to position group', 'true-score sd' jargon). Density heavy: reliability, noise ceilings, Holm/BH, permutation p crowd body; Finding 3 a run-on stack. Finding 4 (TE top speed, n=29) is the only positive yet sits last, R2 0.30 with bootstrap -0.46 to 0.50 undersold. Opening reads 'nothing works'; so-what mostly protocol advice. Why-now leans on audits, thin on football stakes. Captions long and carry results.
top_changes: Shorten title; define BT as 'how much quicker a player's first second is on an NFL snap than in his Combine drill'; drop jargon from main text.
Move statistics to appendix/table; reduce Finding 3 to two sentences plus Fig 5 (baseline R2 0.34, burst adds at most 0.016); shorten captions.
Strengthen motivation and so-what: open with cost of a wrong get-off read; close with scout takeaway (use 40 top speed and film, discount drill); move Finding 4 up and call it a lead not a rule.

changelog: Selected revised candidate (score 7.01) over cand_3 6.70, cand_2 6.52, cand_1 6.41.
Headline is an honest null: DL drill burst vs NFL burst rho 0.02 (n=97), reliability 0.17 drill / 0.07 NFL.
Positive lead: TE 40 top speed vs NFL peak speed rho 0.57 (n=29), no better than official 40.
Evidence: no-tracking baseline, leave-one-class-out R2, permutation, Holm/BH over 18 tests; 1,794 words, 6 figures.
Next round: power/TOST reframing, fix TE n mismatch 33 vs 29, Fig 4 axis, shorter title and body, full game tracking.
